title: Detecting Contaminated Code-Generation Prompt Batches via Influence Functions
abstract: arXiv:2608.14303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet they remain vulnerable to prompts that elicit insecure implementations. Existing defenses typically rely on predefined threat models or known vulnerability patterns, limiting their effectiveness against novel attacks. We propose CodeSIFT, a threat-model-agnostic detection method that leverages influence functions to identify batches of prompts that induce anomalous model behavior. Rather than detecting specific vulnerabilities, CodeSIFT measures the parameter-space influence of generated code and uses a statistical test to determine whether a candidate prompt set deviates from a benign reference distribution. To evaluate our approach, we introduce two benchmark datasets covering a variety of vulnerabilities. We evaluate CodeSIFT on three open-weight code LLMs ranging from 3B to 7B parameters, achieving AUROC scores of up to 0.98 at moderate-to-high injection rate

translated_title: 通过影响函数检测受污染的代码生成提示批次
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于代码生成，但它们仍然容易受到引发不安全实现的提示的影响。现有的防御措施通常依赖于预定义威胁模型或已知漏洞模式，限制了它们对新型攻击的有效性。我们提出了CodeSIFT，一种不依赖特定威胁模型的检测方法，利用影响函数来识别导致模型行为异常的提示批次。CodeSIFT不检测特定漏洞，而是衡量生成代码在参数空间中的影响，并使用统计测试来确定候选提示集是否偏离良性参考分布。为了评估我们的方法，我们引入了两个覆盖多种漏洞的基准数据集。我们在三个参数范围从3B到7B的开源代码LLM上评估了CodeSIFT，在中高注入率下实现了高达0.98的AUROC分数。
tldr: 提出了一种基于影响函数的威胁模型无关检测方法CodeSIFT，能有效识别代码生成提示批次中的污染，在中高注入率下AUROC高达0.98。
en_tdlr: Proposed CodeSIFT, a threat-model-agnostic detection method leveraging influence functions to identify contaminated code-generation prompt batches, achieving AUROC up to 0.98 at moderate-to-high injection rates.
